Scenery composition is not claimed: the Photo2 registry stays empty because ART v3 pixels/alpha/focus clearance and C06 catalog coherence remain unqualified.
No AR02/AR04 criteria reopened; no character fallback used.
The camera-cover path remains unreachable in production while the Photo2 admission registry is empty; the framing is pinned and unit-tested for the future qualified release.
